title: Graffiti Font
author: Angel_Srapix
description:
“A sturdy, block-style display font featuring clean cuts and solid proportions. It offers a structured and confident appearance.
It is useful for sports branding, athletic apparel graphics, and team merchandise.
Included Files:
OTF File (OpenType Font) – Suitable for professional vector design applications.
TTF File (TrueType Font) – Standard format for universal system compatibility.
⚠️ PLEASE NOTE BEFORE PURCHASING:
This font contains only uppercase letters. It does not feature lowercase characters and is designed for prominent headings and uniform-style text.”
